title: Isandro and the Choir
author: Sable Fairweather
blurb: Felix Reyes, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
